key_provisions_or_claims: Sets safety requirements for industrial mobile robots with actively controlled stability (legged, wheeled, self-balancing).
Covers significant hazards under intended use and foreseeable misuse in restricted industrial environments.
Excludes ridden or worn robots, road vehicles, airborne/underwater robots, floor-cleaning robots and non-industrial settings.
Part 2 will address integration of applications.
Currently at CD stage (30.60) under ISO/TC 299.
annotation.summary_en: ISO/CD 25785-1 is a committee draft standard from ISO/TC 299 setting safety requirements for dynamically stable industrial mobile robots (legged, wheeled, self-balancing) in restricted industrial environments. It lists scope exclusions and is the first of a planned series; Part 2 will cover application integration.
